constructor_required_args: dataset (required for run_train/run_test even though the constructor default is None)
iteration_limit_mechanism: max_epoch together with dataset.steps_per_epoch_train and dataset.steps_per_epoch_valid
loss_invocation: SemanticSegmentation.run_train constructs SemSegLoss(self, model, dataset, device). Each training step calls model.get_loss(Loss, results, inputs, device); RandLANet.get_loss then applies filter_valid_label and Loss.weighted_CrossEntropyLoss(scores, labels).
short_note: Instantiate the dataset object first, then pass it together with the model into SemanticSegmentation. For sanity-limited training, keep dataset cfg steps_per_epoch_train small and max_epoch low. The pipeline internally asks the dataset for train and validation splits and starts training through run_train().
